tools.name: penny_get_skill
tools.description: Read the current Penny operating skill when missing or stale, including after a catalog refresh. Reuse files already read this conversation while current. Default SKILL.md; fetch manifest references when their cues apply. Product guidance, separate from user-saved skills; workspace-only access allow

tools.name: penny_start_setup
tools.description: Setup in phases; omit phase to start, resume from meta.onboarding.phase. skipForGood opts out. Stage an encrypted import, show showUser, then save or discard as the user says. While an import is open, finish can't complete setup.

tools.name: penny_session_start
tools.description: Call ONCE at the start of every conversation, before the first substantive reply. First read the installed Penny skill; report its exact metadata via installedSkillStatus/Version/Sha256/Source. Missing or unversioned metadata must not be guessed from plugin/catalog versions; unsupported hosts report

tools.name: penny_read
tools.description:
Before answering anything the user's history, preferences, or prior work would inform, read — search rather than assume nothing is on file.
Choose target: walk this ladder, first match wins:
1. User/people facts (names, preferences, relationships) → profile. Do NOT search notes for this.
2. To-dos/d

tools.name: penny_write
tools.description:
Save the moment something durable emerges — a decision, preference, plan, correction, a to-do, a measurement, or something you produced — mid-conversation and unprompted; when the call is close, save.
Choose entityType: walk this ladder, first match wins:
1. Durable fact about the user or their peop

tools.name: penny_edit
tools.description: When the user corrects something on file, or a task, tracker, skill, or block needs to change, edit the existing item rather than writing a duplicate. Modify what already exists; entityType uses the same taxonomy as penny_write (see ladder). Notes: updates[] patch/replace, max100. Tasks: taskId; can

tools.name: penny_delete
tools.description: Move to Trash. Project: projectId + expectedRevision + operationId; penny_edit op:restore recovers. Repeat in_progress with the same operationId; report partial_recovery conflicts. Note/tracker_entry: ids (max100); skill/rhythm: one id; profile_block: ids are block names. Tag/link removal uses the i
